title: The Lordship of Christ
definition: The lordship of Christ means that Jesus has supreme authority over all creation and every believer's life.
summary: Jesus is Savior and Lord. His people are called to trust Him, obey Him, worship Him, and follow Him.
christFocus: The risen Christ reigns over all and calls His disciples to live under His gracious authority.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Jesus is Savior and Lord. His people are called to trust Him, obey Him, worship Him, and follow Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, trust Him more deeply, and follow Christ with clarity instead of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
